fields.title: How to Apply for PMKSY Drip Irrigation Subsidy in Tamil Nadu (2025 Guide)
fields.summary: Step-by-step guide to applying for the PMKSY drip irrigation subsidy through the TN Horticulture Department — from document collection to disbursement.
fields.content:
# PMKSY Drip Irrigation Subsidy Application Guide

The Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) provides 100% subsidy for drip and sprinkler irrigation to small and marginal farmers in Tamil Nadu.

## Step 1: Check Eligibility
- Land size: Up to 5 acres for 100% subsidy
- Documents: Patta, Chitta, Adangal, Aadhaar, Bank Passbook

## Step 2: Contact Thozhan Irrigation
Call 94895 28432 for a free site assessment.

## Step 3: Document Submission
Our team handles all paperwork submission to the TN Horticulture Department.

## Step 4: Inspection & Installation
Government inspector visits your farm. Thozhan installs the system after approval.

## Step 5: Subsidy Release
Government directly pays the installation cost to Thozhan. Zero out-of-pocket for you.

fields.description: Farmers with land up to 5 acres qualify for 100% subsidy under PMKSY small and marginal farmer scheme.
Farmers with 5.1 to 12 acres qualify for 75% subsidy under TN Horticulture Department scheme.
Farmers with above 12 acres qualify for 50% subsidy. Custom phased installation plan required.
